name: BEND ELECTRIC
address: 63349 NELS ANDERSON RD STE A, BEND, OR 97701

fr.recommendations:
• Mark the single access point with reflective signage identifying all structures served by that entrance.
• Post building identification numbers at each structure (main, secondary, and detached) that are visible from the internal drive aisle.
• Keep the internal drive aisle clear of parked vehicles and stored materials to allow emergency vehicles to reach all structures.
• Mark a designated staging area within the vehicle parking area for emergency vehicles that does not conflict with evacuation movement.
• Keep the outdoor storage area and material storage area clear of the internal drive aisle to avoid blocking emergency vehicle movement.
• Mark a secondary access path to the rear of the main building if one exists, or identify the nearest approach point for responders who need rear access.
• Post a site map at the access road entry point showing the locations of all structures, the dumpster enclosure, storage areas, and the drive aisle layout.
• Keep the dumpster enclosure doors closed and the surrounding area clear to prevent obstruction of drive aisle access.
• Mark the detached building with its own visible address or unit identifier so responders can locate it independently from the main building.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Remove woody debris visible on the property, particularly any accumulations near buildings or along access routes.
• Thin the tree cluster to reduce the concentration of branches and foliage in that area.
• Trim low-hanging branches from scattered trees near buildings and paved areas.
• Cut and remove dry grass cover growing close to structures.
• Clear shrubs growing immediately beside any buildings.
• Keep the rear access route clear of vegetation encroachment to maintain usable passage around structures.
